output.scope_note: The paper is about the Li-ion NASICON solid electrolyte LAGP, but its own conductivities appear only in figures and supplementary tables; the one numeric conductivity in the text is a literature value quoted in the introduction.

records.evidence_quote: LAGP which exhibits one of the highest ionic conductivities (10-4 S.cm-1 at RT) from the oxide group32
records.notes: Generic literature value for LAGP quoted from earlier work (ref 32), not measured in this paper; no composition-specific or method details are given. The paper's own pellet conductivities (grain, inter-grain, total at 650-700 °C) are shown only in Figure 2 and Table S1, with no numeric conductivity values in the text, so no records were made for them. Inter-grain resistivities in ohm.cm are resistivities, not conductivities, and were excluded.
